subject: tally
note: What is true of tally, for scoring a video that explains it. A claim in a script is checked against `statements`; a command shown on screen is checked against `commands` by running it in this folder.

statements.text: tally counts the words of text files
it is a single file with no dependencies
it runs on Node 22 or later
with several files it prints a count for each and a total
with one file it prints no total
--top N lists the N most frequent words across all the files
words with the same count are listed in alphabetical order
--min L counts only words of at least L letters
--json prints the same answer as JSON
with no file it reads standard input
words are compared in lower case: The and the are the same word
an apostrophe is part of a word: keeper's is one word, and is not keeper
it exits 0 on success, 1 when a file cannot be read, 2 when the options are wrong

false.text: tally treats keeper and keeper's, or count and counts, as the same word
tally is installed with npm or is a command on the PATH
